load_compressed_gaussians: load compressed Gaussian splats from a directory and return a GaussianSplats dataclass
truncate_bg_gaussians: truncate background Gaussian splats by filtering with fg_mask threshold
save_gsplat_ply: save Gaussian splats to a PLY file following the standard gsplat convention for 3D viewers
transform_gaussian_splats: apply rotation, translation, and scale transformation to Gaussian splats
rgb_to_sh0: convert RGB color values to spherical harmonic degree-0 coefficients
